summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce an ordinary cash distribution to stockholders of record as of July 31, 2026. Gross distributions were $0.1042 per share across all outstanding classes, with net amounts varying by class after distribution fees, payable on or about August 5, 2026. No shares of Class S, X-2, or A were outstanding, and there were no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or strategic actions. This is a routine distribution disclosure typical of a REIT, not a special situation.
